suggestions.title: Texture hunt
suggestions.description: Go around the house finding things that feel rough, smooth, soft, and hard. Name each one together.

suggestions.title: Name that feeling
suggestions.description: Look at faces in a picture book together. Ask: 'How do you think this person feels?' Accept any answer — the practice of noticing is what matters.

suggestions.title: Pass the toy
suggestions.description: Sit with both children and take turns passing a favourite toy. Narrate: 'Now it's your turn. Now it's their turn.' Builds early sharing awareness.

suggestions.title: Draw your favourite animal
suggestions.description: Ask them to draw their favourite animal and then explain 3 things about it. Encourages imagination and verbal explanation.

suggestions.title: Water the plant
suggestions.description: Give your child one plant to be fully responsible for watering this week. Check on it together each day.

suggestions.title: Make up a story together
suggestions.description: Start a sentence: 'Once there was a...' and let your child finish it. Keep taking turns until the story has a beginning, middle, and end.

suggestions.title: Build it together
suggestions.description: Give both children blocks or Lego and ask them to build one thing together. Don't direct — observe how they negotiate.

suggestions.title: Cook one thing
suggestions.description: Let your child choose and make something simple — toast with a topping, a sandwich, a boiled egg. Real skills, real pride.

suggestions.title: Map your neighbourhood
suggestions.description: Walk around the block together and ask your child to draw a map from memory when you get home. Compare it to reality.

suggestions.title: Three good things
suggestions.description: At bedtime, ask your child to name three things that went well today — big or small. Don't add your own. Listen.

suggestions.title: Solve a puzzle together
suggestions.description: Give both children a jigsaw or brain teaser they can only finish by working together. Watch how they divide the task.

suggestions.title: What matters to you?
suggestions.description: Ask your child to name three things they care deeply about and why. Don't challenge or redirect — this is about listening, not guiding.

suggestions.title: Manage one week's budget
suggestions.description: Give your child a small amount for one category (snacks, entertainment) and let them manage it for a week without top-ups.

suggestions.title: Teach your sibling something
suggestions.description: Ask the older child to teach the younger one something they know well — a game, a skill, a fact. Reinforces both learning and empathy.

suggestions.title: Plan a family outing
suggestions.description: Hand over full planning of one family activity — including logistics, timing, and any bookings. No corrections unless safety is involved.
suggestions.piagetConcept: formal operations — planning and hypothetical thinking

suggestions.title: Letter to your future self
suggestions.description: Ask your teen to write a short letter to themselves 5 years from now. Seal it. Keep it somewhere safe together.
